channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: Some San Diegans still feeling pinch despite government shutdown’s end
item.description: The recent shutdown resulted in some 900,000 federal workers being furloughed, with around two million going without paychecks.

item.title: $50K reward offered for tips in fatal 2018 shooting of barber Arthur Jordan
item.description: Investigators have interviewed witnesses and potential suspects, but have exhausted all leads, so asked the state to offer the reward.

item.title: Illegal crossings at lowest level since 1960s in San Diego Sector, Border Patrol says
item.description: The U.S. Border Patrol Monday announced a significant reduction in illegal border crossings in the San Diego Sector, but an increase in narcotics seizures.

item.title: Poway sets June 2 vote to replace recalled District 2 councilman
item.description: The Poway City Council voted 4-0 Monday to schedule a June 2 special election to fill the vacant District 2 seat.

item.title: ‘Carrots and sticks’ could cut carbon emissions 80% by 2050, UCSD study finds
item.description: A study involving UC San Diego researchers suggests that financial incentives such as clean energy subsidies can significantly reduce greenhouse gas emissions, but without penalties for polluters, climate efforts will be in vain.

item.title: Trump calls for ‘fastest, biggest’ battleship – also plans to help Navy design it
item.description: The ship, according to Trump, will be longer and larger than World War II-era Iowa-class battleships and armed with hypersonic missiles and more.

item.title: Son to stand trial for 80-year-old mother’s fatal beating in Vista
item.description: A man accused of causing fatal injuries to his 80-year-old mother in Vista was ordered Monday to stand trial for second-degree murder.

item.title: Spring Valley SWAT barricade ends with suspect’s surrender
item.description: The suspect was accused of violating a court order. In addition, a check by sheriff's deputies indicated he had a warrant out for his arrest.

item.title: Another lawsuit challenges Harmony Grove project over fire safety concerns
item.description: A new lawsuit is challenging San Diego County Board of Supervisors' approval of the Harmony Grove Village South project, which would add more than 450 homes in a high-risk wildfire area between Escondido and San Marcos.

item.title: Man found dead after suspected shot fired at SD officers in Normal Heights
item.description: A man suspected of firing a shot at San Diego police officers who responded to his call for help in Normal Heights was found dead inside his home Monday, according to law enforcement.
